name: Starless Night of the Console Diver
source:
A rogue hacker is on their hardest job to date. While the big dogs fight for the main server of a megacorp, our protagonist chose to hack into an executive's personal console. How is the world built from recomendation algorithms suited to our victim? Find out in this short story!

[From [url=https://sofiaromao.itch.io/starless-night-of-the-console-diver]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名独行黑客接下了职业生涯迄今最棘手的一单活儿。当各路顶尖高手争相强攻超级企业的主服务器时，我们的主角却另辟蹊径，选择骇入某位高管的私人终端主机。由推荐算法量身构筑的虚拟世界，究竟是如何迎合这位目标人物的？快来这部短篇故事中一探究竟吧！

[摘自[url=https://sofiaromao.itch.io/starless-night-of-the-console-diver]itch.io[/url]]
